answer: Price each identity to a scarce ferrous hardware key that signs a periodic liveness proof, and let standing climb toward a reward summit only after several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet is stranded on a barren tundra: every endorsement traces back to one root, never spanning distinct clusters, so the clones never crest the summit. A farm buys a distinct ferrous anchor per head (linear cost) while an honest agent pays once.
